patch_description: The prior best program (combined 0.57) used this exact pipeline but with two stronger details the current program dropped: (1) a 5-tap binomial post-smoothing kernel [1,4,6,4,1]/16 with edge padding via np.convolve "valid" (smoothness_score 0.21 vs current 0.14, slope_changes 73 vs 128, false_reversals 60 vs 99), and (2) MAD-based scale estimation in the Huber reweighting instead of np.std, plus a second IRLS iteration (np.std is corrupted by the very outliers we downweight, weakening robustness). I restore both, keeping everything vectorized/np.convolve "valid" to preserve the 1.00 efficiency score. The 5-tap binomial kernel is symmetric (zero-phase in the interior), so the extra smoothing costs negligible lag while substantially cutting spurious reversals.
